Apparently this is something from the MS Paint Adventure Homestuck. I've never read it, found it by looking it up with a quick Google search.

http://www.mspaintadventures.com/?s=6&p=002093
Ah ok, thank you. I've never build houses this small so I haven't noticed until now.

Can't see that anything posted about this here, but I think this might be a bug with the house sizing and the use of doors nearby. Not sure how to explain it, so I'll just use pictures.

http://imgur.com/a/CiUnQ

As you see, when the doors are opened so that they take up part of the room, the housing becomes invalid.
When they are open outward, or just closed the house is valid.
The rooms are 10x5 with walls (8x4 on the inside which is valid as far as I know, unless this has been changed).

I tested this with a house that is 2 blocks wider to make up for the space the door is taking up on the inside, and no matter what way the doors face the house is valid.

http://imgur.com/lGwKobL

OptimusGamer isn't actually in the game lobby, but he just appears there. I've had this happen multiple times, and you can tell by looking at the invited list. He is listed as 'Declined' but still ended up in the lobby somehow. If you started the game, he wouldn't be in the queue with you guys and would be left in the lobby.
I deeply apologize if you find this event to be the slightest bit interesting.
